answer.reason: DeclineReason is coarser than the vendor's set. The adapter maps only insufficient_funds and expired_card to named members, and 'other' has no vendor value of its own, so it apparently takes in do_not_honor and lost_card. The core uses the set only for customer-facing messages in CheckoutService's DECLINE_MESSAGES table, which fits the doc comment saying it describes declines "in our own words".
